foods.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
foods.description: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, and pancetta
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente
Sauté the pancetta until crispy
Mix the eggs and cheese in a bowl
Combine pasta with pancetta, then add the egg mixture off heat
Season with pepper and serve immediately

foods.name: Butter Chicken
foods.description: Creamy and flavorful Indian chicken curry
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices for 2 hours
Grill or bake chicken until partially cooked
Make tomato gravy with butter, onions, and spices
Add grilled chicken to the gravy and simmer
Finish with cream and serve with naan

foods.name: Taco Salad
foods.description: Fresh and crunchy Mexican salad with seasoned ground beef
instructions: Brown the ground beef and add taco seasoning
Chop lettuce, tomatoes, and avocado
Rinse black beans and corn
Layer ingredients in a large bowl
Top with cheese, sour cream, and salsa
Add crushed tortilla chips and serve

foods.name: Vegetable Stir Fry
foods.description: Quick and healthy vegetable stir fry with soy sauce
instructions: Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces
Heat oil in a wok over high heat
Add garlic and onion, stir for 30 seconds
Add harder vegetables first (carrots, broccoli)
Add remaining vegetables and stir fry until tender-crisp
Mix soy sauce, honey, and ginger in a bowl
Pour sauce over vegetables and toss to coat
Serve over rice or noodles
